articles.summary: MacDonald to oversee Commercial, Corporate and Specialty Industry banking divisions while continuing leadership of Zions Capital Markets SAN DIEGO, CA — October 26, 2026 — California Bank Trust (CBT), a division of Zions Bancorporation, N.A., and a leading financial institution serving businesses and individuals across the state, today announced the appointment of Michael MacDonald as President. Reporting to CEO Eric Ellingsen, MacDonald will oversee CBT’s Commercial, Corporate and Specialty Industry banking businesses, while working closely with the leadership team on the bank’s broader strategic execution and market expansion across California. A seasoned financial executive with extensive leadership experience, MacDonald will also continue to lead Zions Capital Markets and serve on the Executive Management Committee of Zions Bancorporation.
